title: AxePvP Evolved
description: A lightweight, high-performance Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21+ that optimizes first-person shield vision and adds precise HUD indicators for shield block delays and axe stun cooldowns.
body:
# 🪓 AxePvP Evolved

AxePvP Evolved is a high-performance, lightweight client-side utility mod for Fabric (1.21 - 1.21.11). Designed specifically for competitive Axe PvP, it clears up your visual space and tracks crucial combat timings with a clean, non-intrusive HUD interface.

## 🚀 Key Features

-  **Shield Vision:** Vanilla shields block a massive portion of your first-person view.

What it does: Dynamically offsets the shield model downward and slightly forward.

Benefit: Restores vital screen real estate while keeping full shield protection intact.

Hotkey: F6 (Toggleable)

![Shield Vision](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc585bb4c358f74d5f7a2d78779a935065984a3f.gif)

- **Shield Delay Indicator:** Minecraft shields have a hidden 5-tick (250ms) delay before they start blocking damage.

What it does: Displays a compact, electric blue progress bar below the crosshair during this wind-up phase, flashing green the instant the shield becomes active.

Benefit: Perfect your blocking timing and stop dropping your shield too early.

Hotkey: F7 (Toggleable)

![Shield Delay Indicator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6e408109dc8c1c0156ef26c0d073b2614b149be.png)

- **Shield Stun Tracker:** When an axe disables your shield, a silent 5-second cooldown is applied.

What it does: Displays a vibrant red SHIELD STUNNED: X.Xs timer right above your hotbar.

Benefit: Gives you frame-perfect countdown tracking so you know exactly when you can defend yourself again.

Hotkey: F8 (Toggleable)
